newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Aug aluminium imports up 13.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Aug aluminium imports up 13.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's imports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials reached 424,126 tonnes in the first eight months of 1996, up 13.6 percent compared with the year-ago period, customs figures showed on Monday.
Imports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials in August alone reached 53,533 tonnes.

China's imports of unwrought aluminium including alloys rose 7.3 percent to 248,456 tonnes in the first eight months compared with the year-ago period. Imports of aluminium materials rose 23.8 percent to 175,670 tonnes.
China exported 90,311 tonnes of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials in the first eight months, down 51.1 percent compared with the year-ago period.
Exports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials reached 15,729 tonnes in August.

China's exports of unwrought aluminium including alloys fell 63.5 percent to 55,625 tonnes in the first eight months of the year compared with the year-ago period. Exports of aluminium materials rose 7.3 percent to 34,685 tonnes.
